## Problem

What are you trying to do that Carapace does not let you do today?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest change that would solve it.

## Alternatives

What did you try instead?

## Scope check

Carapace is an execution primitive, not an IDE, browser, or container
platform. Please explain how this fits that scope. Claims about security
behavior must map to a named test (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
